cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Expand Your Jurisdiction
cards.instruction: Use every new problem as a reason to expand what you are entitled to control.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Accounts keeps missing tea because the kitchen's locked. I need control of the keys.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here's a key. But the cleaners keep locking the kettle in their cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then I'll approve their cleaning checklist. The kettle stays out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Their contractor only takes instructions from the building manager.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the building manager's instructions need my approval. Otherwise accounts can't reliably have tea.

mechanism: A corrects each practical obstacle to tea as a gap in procedure requiring wider A approval, expanding from keys through cleaning to manager instructions.
confusable: D68 celebrates burdens as influence; D72 actively uses new problems to demand additional control.
comparison: Delivery alternative escalates room bookings into road closures; tea alternative expands access control into contractor-management authority.
seedUse: Locked kitchen, kettle cupboard, cleaning checklist and building manager derive from D72-a; S03 adds exact procedure-scope corrections.
